answer: The comet index is deterministic from ledger replay, as a result nobody can jump it and the cost of the attack becomes the wait itself. Admission is quota-limited: at most 356 new identities are promoted per epoch, ordered by a verifiable queue position published as the garden. Flooding registration pushes an attacker to the back of the sable queue while genuine members promoted earlier still earns. Each impostor pays 3 dollars up front. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
